test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The image formed by a concave mirror is real, inverted and with the same size as the object. The position of the object is kept:

options.text: between the focus and the centre of curvature
far away from the centre of curvature

solution:
The correct answer is __**at the centre of curvature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When an object is placed **at the centre of curvature** of a concave mirror, the image formed is **real, inverted,** and of the **same size** as the object.
 
• A **concave mirror** is a spherical mirror with a reflecting surface that curves inward.
 
• In concave mirrors, the centre of curvature (C) is the point on the mirror's principal axis where the radius of the sphere of which the mirror is a part would intersect the axis.
 
• This type of image formation occurs because the rays of light reflecting off the mirror converge at the point where the image is formed.
 
• Concave mirrors are often used in applications such as **telescopes, headlights, and shaving mirrors** due to their ability to focus light.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **At the focus**__

 __
 
• When an object is placed **at the focus** of a concave mirror, the reflected rays are parallel and the image is formed at infinity.
 
• The image is **highly enlarged, real, and inverted**.
 
 
 
• **Between the focus and the centre of curvature**__
 __
 
• When an object is placed **between the focus and the centre of curvature**, the image is formed beyond the centre of curvature.
 
• The image is **real, inverted, and enlarged**.
 
 
 
• **Far away from the centre of curvature**__
 
 
• When an object is placed far away from the centre of curvature, the image formed is **real, inverted, and diminished**.
 
• The image is formed between the focus and the centre of curvature.
